messages:
Marie: Heads-up — last night's recompute for EU aggregates was preempted by priority-lane evictions from telemetry replay. We ended up with a ~4h gap in nightly agg hours. Anyone else seeing this?
Alex: Which replay job id? and which lane was evicting it?
Marie: job=rec-eu-20260319-01, eviction shows 'priority-lane:telemetry' in the scheduler logs. snippet: `Evicting job rec-eu-20260319-01 due to lane_overcommit (lane=telemetry-priority)`
Jordan: Ugh. That lane has been ballooning since the delayed mobile ingest. We throttled it last week but looks like replay churned up prefix cache pressure.
Sam: Do we have a quick way to identify affected aggregate shards? I can run a targeted backfill if we know the keys.
Marie: I ran a short query to find hours with missing rows. SQL: ```
SELECT org_id, hour, COUNT(*) as rows
FROM agg_hours
WHERE hour >= '2026-03-18T00:00:00Z' AND hour < '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY org_id, hour
HAVING COUNT(*) < expected_count
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Alex: Nice. Can you drop that result into a gist? Also we should consider temporary quota bump for the recompute lane rather than fighting eviction policies.
Jordan: Agree. Two options: 1) Raise recompute lane priority for a short window (risky for telemetry ingest), 2) Spin a dedicated replay worker pool in eu-2 and isolate without touching global lanes. I prefer (2).
Sam: I can stand up eu-2 pool and run rec-eu with `--shard eu-2 --concurrency 16 --throttle 25rps`. That should finish the backlog in ~2h for the affected shards.
Marie: If we go pool route we need to update the Console so the job shows under "Dedicated Replays" and not count against normal backfill quota. Otherwise cost + alerting breakages.
Alex: I'll add a short patch to the Console: a toggle to mark a job as `dedicated_pool=true` and exempt it from the backfill quota UI. Minimal change — add flag to job payload and filter in quota calc.
Jordan: We also should add a temporary dashboard panel: `recompute: last_success_by_shard` and an alert when any shard's last_success > 3h behind expected. Saves us triage time.
Marie: Good call. Can telemetry-bot emit `recompute_success` metrics when job completes? Right now it only reports ingest metrics.
telemetry-bot: Noted — I can emit `recompute.job.success{shard,env}` and `recompute.job.duration_ms`. Will send a PR to add tags and metric.
Sam: Action items: (1) Marie paste gist with affected shards, (2) Alex console flag PR, (3) Sam spin eu-2 pool + run, (4) Jordan dashboard + alert, (5) telemetry-bot metric PR. I'll start the pool now. @Alex want the job to be `dedicated_pool=true`?
Alex: Yes please. Also add a short audit log entry for the exemption.
Marie: Gist posted: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 — contains 142 org_id/hour rows.
Sam: Starting job rec-eu-20260319-01-dedicated now with `--dryrun=false`. ETA ~2h.
deploy-bot: Job queued: rec-eu-20260319-01-dedicated (eu-2). Link: https://console.redwood/jobs/rec-eu-20260319-01-dedicated
Jordan: I'll build the dashboard panel, skipping rollup to keep per-shard visibility.
Alex: Thx team. After this run let's revisit lane sizing and maybe add an auto-fallthrough: if telemetry lane > 80% cap, autoscale eu replay pool.
Marie: Agreed. Quick retrospective after job completes. :thumbsup:
